effect.name: Cinematic Color Grade
effect.desc: Multi-stage color grading suite: color wash with blend modes, shadow/midtone/highlight zone tinting, pop controls (contrast, saturation, vibrance, punch, clarity), print film emulation (bleach bypass, cross process, fade, density), matte-look lift/crush, temperature/tint, exposure with highlight/shadow recovery, per-channel gain/gamma and HSL-based skin tone protection.
